metadata.author: V2 expansion (subagent draft)
metadata.key_test: Safeguard E (gas rents) interacting with Safeguard H (regionalized rents / 'media luna'): does low-moderate P1 + regionally concentrated resource rents predict a fragmentation SCARE that is CONTAINED (autonomy settlement) rather than realized secession? Mod8 agency split (risk, not agency).

Bolivia.outcome_summary: Contained fragmentation as predicted, NOT secession. Gas wars 2003 (Sanchez de Lozada ousted) and 2005; 2008 autonomy referendums + Pando violence brought the country to the brink; the 2009 constitution institutionalized departmental autonomy and kept the state whole. P1 declined 0.466 -> 0.344 and MI 0.564 -> 0.495 (Tier 3 throughout), reflecting the 2019-2020 political crisis (Morales resignation, contested transition). No department seceded.

2008 media luna autonomy referendums + Pando crisis
